title: "clade_v_pango_plot"

```{r}
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(gt)

```


#read in clade and PANGO lineage counts accessed June 5th  
```{r}
cladenum <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/global-2.tsv") %>% mutate(variant = "clade") %>% 
  rename(name = clade)

#https://data.nextstrain.org/files/workflows/forecasts-ncov/gisaid/pango_lineages/global.tsv.gz

pangonum <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/global.tsv") %>% 
  mutate(variant = "pango") %>% 
  rename(name = clade)

#https://data.nextstrain.org/files/workflows/forecasts-ncov/gisaid/nextstrain_clades/global.tsv.gz


#load in metadata from nextstrain 
#from: 
metadata <- read_tsv("~/growthadvantagecompare/sequences_static/metadata.tsv") 




```
#List of pango lineages + clades to plot 
```{r}
#making list of the PANGO lineages and their corresponding clades 

#group by the clade membership column and find the most common pango lineages within each clade based on nextstrain data 
metadata_clade_pango <- metadata %>%
  group_by(clade_membership) %>%
  count(pango_lineage) 

#strip anything past the third letter from the metadata clade_membership
metadata_clade_pango <- metadata_clade_pango %>% 
  mutate(clade_membership = str_extract(clade_membership, "^[0-9]+[A-Z]"))


#old clade/ pango pairings
 names <- tibble(
   clade = c("21K", "21L", "22B", "23A", "24E", "24A", "25C"),
  pango = c("BA.1", "BA.2", "BA.5", "XBB.1.5", "KP.3.1.1", "JN.1", "XFG")
 )

```

#Plot all sequences volume by day (should be the same)
```{r}
#tot n sequences per day

cladetotn_usa <- cladenum %>% filter(location == "USA") %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% summarise(totn = sum(sequences)) %>% 
  mutate("variant" = "clade")

pangototn_usa <- pangonum %>% filter(location == "USA") %>% 
  group_by(date) %>% summarise(totn = sum(sequences)) %>% 
  mutate("variant" = "pango")


ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = cladetotn_usa %>% filter(variant == "clade"),
           aes(x = date, y = totn, fill = variant), alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(data = pangototn_usa %>% filter(variant == "pango"),
            aes(x = date, y = totn, color = variant), size = .1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("clade" = "coral")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("pango" = "steelblue")) +
  labs(
    title = "Total Sequences Over Time in USA",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Total Sequences",
    subtitle = "same number of sequences between clades and PANGOs"
    ) +
  theme_minimal()

```


```{r}
#proportions of each clade and pango lineage by day 
pangoprops_usa <- left_join(pangototn_usa, pangonum %>% filter(location == "USA"), by = "date") %>% 
 mutate(pangoprop = sequences/totn) 

cladeprops_usa <- left_join(cladetotn_usa, cladenum %>% filter(location == "USA"), by = "date") %>%  
mutate(cladeprop = sequences/totn) 


#filter by %cutoff 
pangoprops_usa_filt <- pangoprops_usa %>% 
  group_by(name) %>% 
  filter(pangoprop > .01) %>% 
  pull(name)

#make vectors of the clades inside the PANGO lineages based on the Nextstrain metadata  
pinc_21K <- (metadata_clade_pango %>% filter(clade_membership == "21K")) %>% 
  pull(pango_lineage)

pinc_21L <- (metadata_clade_pango %>% filter(clade_membership == "21L")) %>% 
  pull(pango_lineage)



#plotting function for all clades in list 

plot1fun <- function(clade) {
  
  # get mindate properly
  mindate <- cladeprops_usa %>% 
    filter(name == clade) %>% 
    filter(cladeprop == max(cladeprop, na.rm = TRUE)) %>% 
    summarise(mindate = min(date) - 150) %>% 
    pull(mindate)
  
  #binding row for BA.5
  p_in_c <- metadata_clade_pango %>% 
    filter(clade_membership == clade) %>% 
    bind_rows(tibble("BA.5")) %>% 
    pull(pango_lineage)

  ggplot() +
    # PANGO lineages
    geom_line(
      data = pangoprops_usa %>% 
        filter(name %in% pangoprops_usa_filt & name %in% p_in_c, date >= mindate, date <= mindate + 300),
      aes(x = date, y = pangoprop, color = name, group = name),
      linewidth = 0.7,
      alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    # Clade line
    geom_line(
      data = cladeprops_usa %>% 
        filter(name == clade, date >= mindate, date <= mindate + 300),
      aes(x = date, y = cladeprop),
      color = "black",
      linewidth = 1.0
    ) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "turbo") +
    labs(
      title = paste(clade, "vs Constituent PANGO Lineages"),
      x = "Date",
      y = "Proportion",
      color = "PANGO lineage"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "right",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
}


plot1fun("21K")

#map function to vector 

#cladelist to map
 names <- tibble(
   clade = c("21K", "21L", "22B", "23A", "24E"),
 )

purrr::map(names$clade, plot1fun)


```

#ai assisted nice plot 
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Base colors for clades
clade_colors <- c(
  "21K" = "#1b9e77",
  "21L" = "#d95f02",
  "22B" = "#7570b3",
  "23A" = "#e7298a",
  "24E" = "#66a61e"
)

cladelist <- c("21K", "21L", "22B", "23A", "24E")



# Build dataset
plot_data <- map_dfr(cladelist, function(clade_i) {
  
  p_in_c <- metadata_clade_pango %>% 
    filter(clade_membership == clade_i) %>% 
    pull(pango_lineage)
  
  pangos <- pangoprops_usa %>% 
    filter(name %in% p_in_c, date >= as.Date("2021-09-01")) %>%
    group_by(name) %>%
    filter(max(pangoprop, na.rm = TRUE) >= 0.02) %>%  # keep ≥2%
    ungroup() %>%
    transmute(
      date,
      value = pangoprop,
      name = as.character(name),
      type = "pango",
      clade = clade_i
    )
  
  clade_line <- cladeprops_usa %>% 
    filter(name == clade_i, date >= as.Date("2021-09-01")) %>%
    transmute(
      date,
      value = cladeprop,
      name = clade_i,
      type = "clade",
      clade = clade_i
    )
  
  bind_rows(pangos, clade_line)
})

# Clean types
plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    name = as.character(name),
    clade = factor(clade, levels = cladelist)
  )

# Build PANGO color gradients
color_map <- map(cladelist, function(clade_i) {
  
  base_color <- clade_colors[clade_i]
  
  pango_names <- plot_data %>%
    filter(clade == clade_i, type == "pango") %>%
    pull(name) %>%
    unique()
  
  light_color <- alpha(base_color, 0.35)
  grad_cols <- colorRampPalette(c(light_color, base_color))(length(pango_names))
  names(grad_cols) <- pango_names
  
  grad_cols
}) %>% 
  unlist()

# Plot
figure_1 <- ggplot() +
  
  # PANGO lineages
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(type == "pango"),
    aes(x = date, y = value, color = name, group = name),
    linewidth = 0.7,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  
  # Clade lines (mapped for legend)
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(type == "clade"),
    aes(x = date, y = value, color = clade, linetype = clade),
    linewidth = 1.4
  ) +
  
  # Color scale (only show PANGOs in color legend)
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(color_map, clade_colors),
    breaks = names(color_map),
    name = "PANGO lineage"
  ) +
  
  # Separate clade legend
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = rep("solid", length(cladelist)),
    labels = paste("Clade", cladelist),
    name = "Clade"
  ) +
  
  # Fix y-axis
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1)) +
  
  # Facet vertically
  facet_wrap(~clade, ncol = 1) +
  
  # Legend styling
  guides(
    linetype = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(
        linewidth = 1.5,
        color = clade_colors
      )
    ),
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(linewidth = 0.8)
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    title = "US Clades vs Constituent PANGO Lineages",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Proportion of total sequences"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

figure_1

```

```{r}

ggsave(

  plot = figure_1,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  units = "in"
)
```
